# Enhance Automation Reliability and Safe Delivery Paths

**Issue for Automation Reliability Improvements**

This issue focuses on ensuring automation workflows are reliable and safe. Recent efforts include fixing dependency issues in the mirror swarm and improving Telegram integration.

## Goal
- Document and verify automation reliability improvements.
- Ensure all automation tasks are tested and verified.
- Fix dependency issues in the mirror swarm and Telegram integration.
- Implement safeguards to prevent failures in critical workflows.

## Acceptance Criteria
- All automation tasks are tested and verified for reliability.
- Dependency issues in the mirror swarm and Telegram integration are resolved.
- Safeguards are in place to prevent failures in critical workflows.
- Fixes and improvements are documented for future reference.

## Related Work
- Fixes for dependency issues in the mirror swarm (e.g., commits #455, #453).
- Improvements in Telegram outreach and bot routing (e.g., commits #446, #448).
- Safe delivery path enhancements for OpenClaw automation.
